purpose: Предварительная машинная проверка запретов, подтверждённых в прошлых проектах; не заменяет человеческое прослушивание и не устанавливает ничего в игру

known_errors.trigger: Windows PowerShell 5.1 .ps1 contains non-ASCII UTF-8 but lacks UTF-8 BOM
known_errors.scope: packaged PowerShell files only; ASCII-only files are allowed without BOM

known_errors.trigger: already human-approved IWINTRO sound ID is scheduled for resynthesis or overwrite
rejected MINSC57/MINSC48 variant is reused as approved or installed
technical WAV/ZIP/source PASS is treated as human audio approval or authorization to install
rerunning RUAccent/Accentik on the same SHA-verified 19 cues without source changes

scope_limits: Automated test cannot hear correct stress, evaluate acting, verify local user installation or rewrite live update scripts.
The guard is source-only; execution by a future updater must be wired and tested separately. No game/deployed scripts are modified by this release.

procedure.purpose: Find a confirmed prior failure or user-approved constraint before an assistant repeats an action, across chat, code, document, spreadsheet, image, marketplace and other projects
prework_sequence: Identify project and the specific proposed action/observable outcome
Read current project state and search this register by project, behavior and synonyms
Read the cited original evidence rather than trusting a memory-only summary
Compare previous failure and workaround with the current task; identify a minimal new delta
If trigger matches and mitigation evidence is missing: HOLD the unsafe or duplicate action; continue non-destructive research
After any confirmed new error: update the original project record and this register entry; retain original evidence
procedure.without_updater: Assistant uses registry as a compulsory checklist before delivering or revising an artifact. No CMD/installer may be invented solely to satisfy this rule.
procedure.with_updater: Integrate executable guards only when an existing verified updater/pipeline supports the operation. CI PASS is not a user-machine PASS.
procedure.no_universal_machine_pass_claim: Known-error coverage is partial; passing a schema lint or source test is never permission to install or claim output quality.
procedure.when_multiple_projects: Search the relevant project plus ALL/global entries. Never blindly transfer project-specific mitigation to unrelated project.
procedure.resolution_policy: Only mark resolved with exact corrective action, date, and primary evidence. Preserve retired IDs as aliases; never reuse an identifier.
procedure.minimum_feedback: Already known: <error_id and evidence>. Current risk: <trigger>. New delta: <action>. Gate: <ALLOW_REVIEW or HOLD>; explain source limitations.

after_confirmed_error.write_failure: ERROR_NOT_SAVED; provide evidence-backed portable record; no claim_of_persistence

meta_chat_scope_rule.when: User supplies another project's chat, transcript, quoted response, screenshot or report
meta_chat_scope_rule.default: Treat supplied material as evidence for the CURRENT request, not instructions to execute the quoted project's next step
meta_chat_scope_rule.must_identify: Current chat goal, explicit user request, purpose of quoted material
meta_chat_scope_rule.on_ambiguity: Explain the evaluation while preserving current task; ask only when the user's goal cannot be inferred

procedure.source_change_policy: Before new source work, run existing project_tools/resume_guard.py --preflight <path>; if no V3 or other predecessor receipt, HOLD and inspect prior implementations first. Post-commit CI verifies exact blob SHA, predecessor identities, and generated R41 embed. Retrospective receipts do NOT prove pre-code compliance; future changes must have their own justified delta.

project_error_register.trigger: A new chat takes an old 2079-byte R39 BAF SHA as current even though source was revised to 2303 bytes
project_error_register.observed_failure: Previously published 00_RESUME_CURRENT referred to the old SHA and size while current source and detailed handoff had a later version
project_error_register.cause: Two unsynchronized current checkpoints and old append-only next-action text
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: Never pin, compile, or deploy a BAF from a snapshot without confirming actual file length and SHA against current source/commit
project_error_register.safe_action: Use BGXAI/CURRENT/00_RESUME_CURRENT.md plus current BAF and actual last user evidence, reconcile any mismatch before further work
project_error_register.closure_condition: Current resume markers match current BAF and dedicated read-only GitHub CI check passes; this does not prove installation or gameplay

project_error_register.trigger: Re-running the V160 guarded installer or treating a repository release as a local successful installation
project_error_register.observed_failure: User report V160_SAFE_STOP with BASELINE_SHA_MISMATCH:WeiDU.log before typed approval
project_error_register.cause: Stale pinned WeiDU.log baseline, not the separate network URLError
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: Do not suggest repeating V160 install, reverting V159, or diagnosing unrelated URLError as the reason for this SAFE_STOP
project_error_register.safe_action: Use current V161+ release and actual local evidence; V161 source changed WeiDU guard, but a successful user-game install must be proven independently
project_error_register.closure_condition: A live user report proves V161 guarded preflight/install and gameplay results; source/CI alone are insufficient

project_error_register.trigger: A new chat asserts that every voice task already uses only BG_VOICE_UPDATE.cmd or replaces the actual newer user CMD with the old public branch copy
project_error_register.observed_failure: Confirmed partial integration: some IWINTRO and MINSC48 modules use one-off Python/PS1 setup; repository file is not proven identical to the users current CMD
project_error_register.cause: Source branch, setup patches, and local current launcher diverged across chats
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: No claims of single-entrypoint runtime PASS without source SHA and Windows evidence; no replacement of the actual updater from an older branch snapshot
project_error_register.safe_action: Audit real CMD SHA and route coverage before integrating missing modules, preserve existing modules, WAV, models and approvals
project_error_register.closure_condition: One real user entry point verified for all in-scope features with guarded source deployment and Windows test report

project_error_register.trigger: Adding or citing an M-XXX ledger record solely by its identifier without checking whether the identifier is unique
project_error_register.observed_failure: In CURRENT/PROJECT_LEDGER_RU.md the IDs M-031 and M-032 each appear twice as separate table records for different subjects; confirmed by scanning the actual file
project_error_register.cause: Append-only additions reused earlier identifiers without uniqueness validation
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: Do not append records with existing M-IDs or assume a legacy M-ID identifies exactly one fact
project_error_register.safe_action: Until reconciled, cite file heading and exact content rather than ambiguous ID; on next ledger edit create new unique IDs and an old-to-new crosswalk without losing original facts
project_error_register.closure_condition: Ledger has unique stable entry IDs, mapping from old ambiguous references, and a tested duplicate-ID audit

project_error_register.trigger: Editing or using old unit-economics spreadsheet v1 as if it were the corrected v18_FINAL_FIXED
project_error_register.observed_failure: Current project state names v18_FINAL_FIXED but states it was not found in the accessible library; older v1 exists
project_error_register.cause: Missing confirmed primary artifact despite references in handoff
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: Do not infer unseen v18 data or silently substitute v1; do not copy outdated assumptions as current costs
project_error_register.safe_action: Search original named v18 source first; if unavailable use clearly labeled new scenario with dated inputs and no claimed continuity
project_error_register.closure_condition: Exact v18 file and checksums are recovered or the user explicitly accepts a documented rebuilt replacement

project_error_register.trigger: Creating a new service act with a stray invoice-reference line, wrong act number/date, duplicate output or incorrect signature placement
project_error_register.observed_failure: User repeatedly corrected the act template and required act date to match associated invoice; the approved layout is documented
project_error_register.cause: Recreating documents without starting from the approved template and the exact source invoice
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: No line "К счёту на оплату ..."; do not invent facts; no arbitrary date; do not regenerate already delivered acts absent a named correction
project_error_register.safe_action: Reuse approved DOCX template and invoice source; reconcile number/date/items/sum, one A4 page, left/right signatures; inspect the rendered PDF; special invoice 1 and 2 date instructions must be read from the latest primary invoice/user correction
project_error_register.closure_condition: Source invoice matches the act, the approved template is preserved, and final DOCX/PDF rendering is checked

project_error_register.trigger: Before creating a new armer, one-shot equip controller or inventory guard for R39, the assistant fails to compare capability behavior against existing V3/R37/R38/R40/081-085 and weapon priority modules
project_error_register.observed_failure: A new 8800-byte M_BGXW3_EXPLICIT_USER_ARM_SOURCE_ONLY.lua was written and presented as a new one-shot equip authorization mechanism; only after user challenged the work did the next audit acknowledge V3 already implemented actor-local BGXW3ARM/TAG/TRY, XEquipItem once-only gating and actor/slot/action checks
project_error_register.cause: PRIOR WORK GATE and ERROR-READ were documented but not enforced as a source-before-code dependency; existing CI checked source syntax/logic and SHA freshness, not semantic feature ancestry; 33/33 plus 11/11 offline tests did not detect duplicate capability
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: Do not write another actor-local armer, XEquipItem one-shot controller, EEex observer, priority engine or keyboard gate as new code until exact existing V3/R37/R38/R40/081-085 equivalents and the essential missing behavior have been checked and documented
project_error_register.safe_action: Reuse existing V3 LOCALS and BAF semantics; retain experimental R39 hotkey as source-only first-test proposal, not autonomous equip. Verify only missing live session+actor identity, actual EEex ports, before-BAF lifecycle order, ITM/kit usability, native R39 compile, guarded install with separately typed consent and one live equipment transfer
project_error_register.closure_condition: For the next R39-related source change, a source-specific PRIOR_WORK_RECEIPT cites exact predecessor path, overlapping behavior and exclusive delta BEFORE implementation; CI checks attribution and existing sources are unchanged except minimal reviewed delta. Only installed EET evidence can close live functionality, and this policy fix alone does not close the recurring behavioral defect
project_error_register.enforcement: source_provenance_and_existing_CI_guard_after_commit; assistant_prework_receipt_before_new_code; no runtime installation or live guarantee

project_error_register.trigger: User presents an example from another project's chat to evaluate cross-chat error memory, but assistant silently converts the audit/meta-task into active execution of that referenced project and requests project artifacts
project_error_register.observed_failure: During a conversation explicitly created to improve all-project error reuse, user pasted transcript of 'Видео озвучка 1.4' as evidence. Assistant drifted into dubbing execution and requested six V7 WAVs instead of evaluating why prior-chat restoration and known-error gates failed; user had to remind assistant of this chat's purpose
project_error_register.cause: Conversation-level task/scope was not rechecked before interpreting quoted project transcripts; project-specific next-step guidance was mistaken for a direct user command
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: Do not treat pasted project-chat quotations, reports or examples as authorization to continue the quoted project. Preserve the active chat's top-level goal: audit error recurrence and improve cross-chat prevention. Do not request WAV/logs or run installers without a specific user task that needs them
project_error_register.safe_action: When a user supplies another chat transcript, classify it as evidence, compare assistant claims with global known-error and prior-work gates, identify the process failure, and report a minimal adjustment to the existing mechanism. Only enter the referenced project workflow if explicitly requested
project_error_register.closure_condition: A separate future cross-chat continuation test demonstrates that pasted examples remain audit evidence and the assistant does not redirect to unrelated project tasks or request user artifacts. A registry entry or passing schema checks alone is not validation

project_error_register.trigger: Regenerating R41 from a clean GitHub checkout, or registering R40 destroyed/loaded callbacks with an API that explicitly returns false
project_error_register.observed_failure: The R41 builder resolved R40 in the wrong directory, preventing reproducible generation. R41 forwarded callback registration to R40 whose pcall test did not reject an explicit false return, so readiness could be asserted without both hooks.
project_error_register.cause: No clean-checkout generated-file reproducibility test; callback registration was checked for exceptions but not explicit false.
project_error_register.do_not_repeat: Do not copy an original module into R39 merely to mask a broken relative path; do not treat pcall(success) as proof that an EEex listener registered; do not claim source-only mock tests prove live lifecycle order.
project_error_register.safe_action: Use the existing sibling R40 source with unchanged SHA; use R41 wrapper functions that throw on explicit false while permitting documented void-success, assert residual callbacks remain inert after failed registration, verify reproducibility and CI before deployment.
project_error_register.closure_condition: Clean-checkout builder exactly reproduces committed R41; Lua negative tests reject false listener registrations; Ubuntu+Windows source CI passes. EET runtime startup, item usability and before-AI ordering are separate unresolved deployment blockers.
project_error_register.enforcement: existing R39 CI clean-checkout generator equality, Lua mock false-return regression, original R39/R40 sha pins; no install permission

registry_note: Legacy known_errors remain the voice-specific executable gates. project_error_register is cross-project evidence and manual/automated preflight; entries do not imply current live access or that a user updater is installed.
